4-1.translation: Subhuti, someone who has correctly entered the awakening hero's vehicle should think like this: 'I must help all kinds of living beings. This includes those born from eggs, or born from a womb. It includes those born from warmth and moisture, or miraculously born. It includes those having a shape, and those without form. It includes those having ideas, and those without ideas. It even includes those neither with ideas nor without ideas. However many exist in the realm of living beings, I will lead them all to complete freedom from sorrow in the expanse of freedom from sorrow with no group left over.'

issues.span: However many exist in the realm of living beings
issues.evidence: Academic: 'however many are designated by conceptual designation as sentient beings in the realm of sentient beings' - they are merely called/designated living beings; 'exist' asserts real existence and drops the designation point that sets up the paradox in 4-2.
issues.fix: However many are called living beings in the realm of living beings, I will lead them all to complete freedom from sorrow in the expanse of freedom from sorrow with no group left over.

12-24.translation: Furthermore, Subhuti, think of a great awakening hero who fills countless world realms with the seven precious things and gives them all away as a gift. Now think of a son of a good family or a daughter of a good family. They might write down, learn, keep, read, understand, or fully teach others even just a four-line verse from this perfection, perfect wisdom. This person will create much more stored-up goodness. It will be too great to count or measure.

issues.span: think of a great awakening hero ... Now think of a son of a good family or a daughter of a good family. ... This person will create much more stored-up goodness.
issues.evidence: Academic: the merit of the one who writes/teaches even a four-line verse is "much more" than (compared to) the merit of the bodhisattva great being who fills world systems with the seven precious substances and gives them; the comparison between the two is the point.
issues.fix: Furthermore, Subhuti, imagine a great awakening hero who fills countless world realms with the seven precious things and gives them all away as a gift. Now imagine a son or daughter of a good family who writes down, learns, keeps, reads, understands, or fully teaches others even just a four-line verse from this perfect wisdom. This person creates much more stored-up goodness than the hero did, too great to count or measure.

8-65.translation: Also, Subhuti, any place where this sacred text is taught will deserve respect. It will be honored by the world with its gods, humans, and jealous gods.

issues.fix: use the locked rendering: world with its gods, people, and jealous gods

8-98.translation: That is why the Thus-Gone One Dipankara foretold this to me: "Brahmin boy, in the future you will become the Thus-Gone One, the worthy one, the complete Buddha named Shakyamuni."
